study type: Data resource description for a cohort study
exposure: Fetal presentation at various stages of pregnancy
outcome: Status of the newborn immediately post-delivery
Signs, symptoms, and treatments of newborn babies (during hospital stay or midwife care)
cohort: The children in the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) cohort, for whom fetal and neonatal clinical records were abstracted.
finding: This data note describes the detailed data abstracted from clinical medical records concerning fetal health (monitoring, presentation), method of delivery, and neonatal status (post-delivery status, signs, symptoms, treatments) for the ALSPAC cohort.
mod_finding: Data on the method of delivery were abstracted from clinical records.
